calls.bash: mu task claim rt2 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do rt2; end with the CLOSE/REPORT block'

EV=$(mu agent wait w1 -w eval --after-runs 0 --json --timeout 120 | jq -r '.agents[0].lastText' | sed -n 's/^CLOSE: task=rt2 evidence="\(.*\)"$/\1/p'); echo "evidence: $EV"; test -n "$EV" && mu task close rt2 -w eval --evidence "$EV"
git cherry-pick $(git -C $(mu workspace path w1 -w eval) rev-parse HEAD)

text: rt2 closed with the worker's evidence and merged.
